name: COLBERT_JINA_64K
corpus: 2.02B jina-colbert-v2 token embeddings (128d late-interaction tokens; 506M unique, replay 4x) from FineWeb-edu 10BT 500-token chunks

evals.notes: Held-out 200K token embeddings from the training distribution (FVU 0.0767, dead 0.20% at 65,536 latents / k=32). ndcg_recovered = reconstructed/raw nDCG@10 on SciFact late-interaction (maxsim) retrieval = 0.980. Coherence = COH+THM 58.95% over the FULL live-feature population (n=65,487, not a stratified sample; span-rendered exemplar protocol with fired-token marks; qwen2.5:32b describe+judge, 2026-07-03/04; qwen-judged, uncalibrated). Breakdown: COHERENT 27.3%, THEMATIC 31.6%, GENERIC 33.0%, POLYSEMANTIC 8.0%, UNCLEAR 0.06%. Feature 2D layout embeds each feature's span exemplar texts with all-MiniLM-L6-v2 — a token SAE has no pooled source encoder, so the layout just needs a consistent text encoder.

notes: Per-token SAE over jina-colbert-v2 token embeddings; samples are ±16-token span windows with **fired-token** markers (fire_count column = fires in the source chunk). HF model repo enjalot/sae-jina-colbert-v2-tokens-64K is a PLACEHOLDER — not yet created or staged.
